# CleanGutters Lighting

CleanGutters Lighting is an owner-installed exterior home-services company based in Cherry Hill, New Jersey. Alex installs every job personally rather than using subcontractors.

## Core services

- Micro-mesh gutter guard installation
- Professional gutter cleaning and repair
- Seamless gutters and downspouts
- Permanent app-controlled exterior roofline LED lighting

## Service area

South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, Northern Delaware, and nearby parts of Northeastern Maryland.

## Key facts

- In business since 2009
- Phone: 856-874-6640
- Email: cleangutters2008@gmail.com
- Free on-site estimates
- Transferable lifetime warranties are available on qualifying gutter protection systems

## Core service pages

- [Gutter guards](https://cleangutterslighting.com/gutters): Owner-installed LeafBlaster Pro micro-mesh gutter guards by Gutterglove
- [Permanent lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/lighting): Oelo permanent roofline lighting with app control
- [Gutter services](https://cleangutterslighting.com/gutter-services): Gutter cleaning, repair, replacement, downspouts, fascia and soffit
